Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are pleased to present our pricing and standard terms for your requirements.

For this item, we can offer a price of €6.10 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, and no Preisgleitklausel. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

To give you some background on our current cost structure, AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost, while PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost.

We value our business relationship and look forward to serving you from our extensive product range.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

move.subject: Re: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels)
move.body:
Dear Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH team,

You explain your offer through specific cost shares rather than simply quoting a price; it sounds like demonstrable cost recovery is central to your proposal. We are prepared to exchange a longer contractual commitment for a more competitive price, giving you continuity while grounding our agreement in transparent costs. What scope for that exchange can you substantiate by sharing your cost-breakdown XLSX, separating material, processing and other costs?

We confirm a binding volume of 23,700 units per year for 24 months. Our recent orders for Round bar 1.4404 dia 30 mm, peeled were at 5.26, 5.84 per 1 (po:4500014292-10, po:4500014355-10, po:4500014427-10). Alloy surcharge 1.4404, Isartal Edelstahlwerk (fictional mill, derived) changed -5.5% from 2026-06 to 2026-09 (idx:AS-14404@2026-06, idx:AS-14404@2026-09). Producer prices DE: cold drawing of bars changed -2.3% from 2026-06 to 2026-08 (idx:PPI-C2431@2026-06, idx:PPI-C2431@2026-08). Our current contract passes PPI-C2431 on at 80% weight (ctr:4600070740#3.2), while your quote states it is 38% of your cost; that clause has already raised our price by 11% this year. Other suppliers currently quote this part at about EUR 5.45. We understand a change of this size needs your pricing committee; please put this proposal to them. Could you share your cost breakdown for this part, so we can understand the drivers together?

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (EUR 4.77 per unit, no index clause, 45 days payment, 24 months; EUR 4.76 per unit, no index clause, 30 days payment, 24 months; EUR 4.74 per unit, no index clause, 14 days payment, 24 months). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Attached: our monthly call-off schedule for the full contract term.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.

We checked the index change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We checked the price history data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. That remains. LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost. That remains. PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost. That remains. Material accounts for about 45 % of our cost; more detail we do not share. Our price follows our main cost drivers: AS-14404, PPI-C2431, LCI-C.

We welcome the 24-month volume commitment, which enables us to offer a revised base price of EUR 5.40 with 30 days payment. Please note that for a two-year term, we must apply the AS-14404 index clause, as we cannot absorb long-term material risk. We can offer a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404, AS-14404, AS-14404.

Our present Angebot is a price of €5.30 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. 

Beside this, we offer a price of €5.40 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. Alternatively, with a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404: €5.40 per unit.

Please send us the competing offer you mentioned. Our offer is valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

move.subject: Re: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels)
move.body:
Dear Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH team,

Your repeated emphasis on indexation suggests that protection from material-cost risk is central to your willingness to commit long term. We want a dependable commercial relationship in which risk protection earns a corresponding reduction in the base price. How can you reflect that reduced exposure in your pricing, and what further reduction would faster payment unlock?

We confirm a binding volume of 23,700 units per year for 24 months. Our demand forecast for Round bar 1.4404 dia 30 mm is up +1.9% (fc:370010@2026-09).

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (EUR 4.86 per unit, AS-14404 index clause (45% share, 0% deadband), 30 days payment, 24 months; EUR 4.84 per unit, AS-14404 index clause (45% share, 0% deadband), 14 days payment, 24 months). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. We have reviewed your updated demand forecast; however, the minor volume increase does not impact our calculation. 

Our price follows our main cost drivers: AS-14404, PPI-C2431, LCI-C. A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price. Which volume can you commit to?

Our current offer stands at a price of €5.30 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. Our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net. 

We value your proposal of a 14-day payment term, which enables us to offer a further reduction in the base price. Consequently, we propose EUR 5.20 per unit for a 24-month agreement with 14 days payment and the AS-14404 index clause. As an alternative, we offer a price of €5.20 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. 

This offer is valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

move.body:
Dear Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH team,

You distinguish forecast growth from binding commitments—it sounds like dependable business, rather than a revised forecast, is what creates pricing room for you. We want a durable agreement that gives you commercial certainty and us a transparent, defensible base price. What base-price reduction can that certainty support, and can you share your cost-breakdown workbook so we can examine the underlying elements?

We confirm a binding volume of 23,700 units per year for 24 months. Our recent orders for Round bar 1.4021 dia 40 mm, peeled were at 2.88, 3.2 per 1 (po:4500014312-10, po:4500014367-10, po:4500014441-10).

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (EUR 4.94 per unit, AS-14404 index clause (45% share, 0% deadband), 30 days payment, 24 months). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Attached: our monthly call-off schedule for the full contract term.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

Dear customer,

Thank you for your continued interest in our products. We checked the price history data you cited; however, it refers to a different part and material, so it does not affect our calculation. Furthermore, the price history data you cite does not concern this part or our company. Which figures is that based on? Please send us the data. Regarding your request, we do not share our internal cost-breakdown workbooks. Material accounts for about 45 % of our cost; more detail we do not share.

Acknowledging your monthly call-off schedule, we can reduce our base price to EUR 5.20 for a 24-month agreement with 30 days payment. 

This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. To summarize our Angebot, we present a price of €5.20 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months, and a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. This offer stays valid for 7 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH
